# DRF — GitHub AI Bootstrap

This file is intentionally thin. Root `AGENTS.md` is universal governance; **Skills are the operating interface**.

Before substantive work:

1. Read root `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read `skills/README.md`.
3. Select the single best owning Skill and read its `SKILL.md` before acting.
4. Resolve/create the governing GitHub Issue before durable substantive changes.
5. Treat current repository files and verified evidence as more authoritative than chat/model memory.

## Skill routing

- New business opportunity / market intelligence / scoring / niches / underwriting / V3 close-out → `skills/drf-opportunity-factory/SKILL.md`
- Discovery / daily portfolio calibration / scheduled refresh / specialist intelligence → `skills/drf-recurring-intelligence/SKILL.md`
- Dashboard V3 / website / data-contract / Pages work → `skills/drf-dashboard-operations/SKILL.md`
- Repository architecture / Skills / governance / CI / cleanup → `skills/drf-repository-operations/SKILL.md`

Do not create global templates, AI workflows, SOPs, lessons, prompt files or miscellaneous knowledge folders. Improve the owning Skill instead.

## Material opportunity close-out

Material opportunity/niche research must finish through the Opportunity Factory Skill:

```text
authoritative source
→ affected registers
→ Layer 3/current dossier where required
→ businesses/PORTFOLIO-V3.md LAST
   OR businesses/V3-RECONCILIATIONS.md explicit NO FIELD CHANGE
→ validation
```

Never use `index.html` as the business-data write path.

## Change path

Substantive work:

```text
Issue → issue-linked branch → focused change → PR → checks/review → merge → verify
```

## Security

Never expose or commit secrets, credentials, private keys, payment data or unapproved customer personal data.
